examples.en: Underwood summed it up as "a first effort, naive, stiff, quaky and innocent a ticket into the marketplace".
examples.zh: 安德伍德将其总结为“第一张努力，天真、生硬、颤栗、天真的进入市场的门票”。

examples.en: As though spring woke in the heart's cold Underwood.
examples.zh: 仿佛春天从心灵寒冷的深处醒来。

examples.en: He gave me his old Underwood typewriter and I set it up in the basement.
examples.zh: 他给我的是一台安德伍牌老式打字机，我把它架在地下室里。
